notes.title: Update: Copy-Paste Feature
notes.content: Players can now copy polls and create them by pasting them into Twitch chat or directly into Stream Polls.

notes.title: COPY-PASTE FEATURE
notes.content:
Design your poll and COPY IT!!

Select "Copy to Clipboard" when right-clicking on the poll!
